## Meet Fortrea at AASLD: The Liver Meeting 2026


Fortrea will be in Denver for AASLD: The Liver Meeting 2026 and looks forward to connecting with sponsors, investigators, and industry leaders. Backed by decades of experience in liver research, our team is ready to discuss strategies for accelerating development, navigating complex challenges, and advancing clinical programs with confidence. Meet with our team to learn how Fortrea can help bring your liver therapies to patients faster and with confidence.
